card.name: Inside the word kilogram or kilometer
card.fires_on: The "kil" or "il" piece of metric words such as kilogram, kilometer, kilowatt and kilobyte, usually right after a number or "per". Also "metric" before "tons".

modes.label: After a number
modes.description: The "il" piece in a hyphenated number-plus-unit like 5-kilometer.

modes.label: After per or in a header
modes.description: The "kil" piece of kilogram after "per" or in a weight table heading.
modes.example: Weight Range (<<kil>>ograms) Dosage less than or equal

card.writes: It helps complete the word with the rest of the metric unit, such as ogram or ometer.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of metric units that start with kilo, like kilogram or kilometer.
